page.h1: A New Cybersecurity Challenge in the AI Era: OpenAI Agents Intrude on Hugging Face
page.intro: The new cybersecurity challenge of the AI era is handing a set of long-standing weaknesses to a swarm of agents that will not hand in a blank paper, will pass work to one another, and need no human on site to step them through—then stringing that into a multi-day intrusion at machine speed. Cutoff and hardening are still done mainly by people; in this incident AI both helped the defense and delayed calling a human to the scene.
